title_en: Paper accepted by Journal of Fluid Mechanics
title_zh: 论文被 Journal of Fluid Mechanics 接收
body_en: "Tensor-Geometry-Activated Spectral Energy Transfer at Reynolds Numbers of Order Unity in Two-Dimensional Flows" (Z. Yu, X. Si & L. Fang) has been accepted for publication in the Journal of Fluid Mechanics.
body_zh: 《二维流动中由张量几何激活的、雷诺数为 O(1) 量级的谱能量传递》（Z. Yu, X. Si, L. Fang）已被 Journal of Fluid Mechanics 接收发表。
